description: minimumReleaseAge does not cover lockfile updates. Cargo resolves through update-lockfile, so a compatible crate can enter Cargo.lock before the window is up.

packageRules.description: Held at the versions cssparser, selectors and tiny-skia-path resolve to. A newer major lands a second copy of the crate in the tree.
These move together, and html5ever waits on markup5ever_rcdom to follow it. A group of their own keeps a blocked bump from holding back the other updates.
The layout, shaping and font stack moves by hand: taffy is pinned by decision, and harfrust and the fontations family resolve to takumi's forks through [patch.crates-io].
0.28 needs rolldown 1.2, which tsdown does not use yet. Under an older rolldown its CommonJS declarations lose `export =`, and attw rejects @takumi-rs/image-response.
